news.summary: The Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) has launched 6G-FORMOSA, a shared testbed platform developed in collaboration with Keysight Technologies to accelerate 6G technology validation.

news.summary: The European Union has delayed a meeting to consider the bloc-wide approval of Tesla's 'Assisted Driving' system until December 15.
